title: They Were Forced to Buy a $7,000 Warranty
summary: A compilation of dealership encounters includes a buyer told an extended warranty was mandatory, who later got a full refund after cancelling it.

assertions.quote: they told her she had to buy an extended warranty

verdicts.note: A documented illegal practice (tying) reported by buyers and confirmed when refunds were issued after the fact.

assertions.quote: she got a hold of those people that she got the service contract through and take off that service contract
